name: @fastvideo/dreamverse-voice-acting
description: Installable DreamVerse voice acting bundle: record your lines in a Voice tab, convert them to an allowed voice with a Seed-VC server, and render shots lip-synced to them; it adds @fastvideo/dreamverse-voice-convert, @fastvideo/dreamverse-seed-vc, @fastvideo/dreamverse-ui-voice-convert, and @fastvideo/dreamverse-workflow-voice to a DreamVerse profile and ships the Seed-VC server.
